Kecleon

Normal

Kecleon is a Normal-type Color Swap Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 22 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (120), with a base stat total of 440.
